Source: OpenAI image generation through Codex built-in `image_gen`.
Target use: concept reference for rebuilding the Expedition cockpit/ship from Three.js primitives in `src/visuals.js`.
Asset type: concept art for a Three.js first-person ship/cockpit model that can be rebuilt from simple primitives.
Primary request: Design a small 6DOF asteroid-mining drone cockpit/ship that matches a low-poly asteroid cave game scene. The current environment is faceted brown/charcoal rock ...
Scene/backdrop: first-person view inside a low-poly asteroid mine tunnel, warm brown rock, mineral veins, crystals, subtle PBR roughness, readable silhouette.
Subject: foreground ship/cockpit occupying the bottom third of the image, built only from primitives that are easy to reproduce in Three.js: cubes/boxes, cylinders, cones, torus...
Design language: rugged mining drone, low-poly industrial, flat-shaded human-made geometry with PBR textures, large readable forms, asymmetrical practical details, compact hull,...
Materials: matte graphite and dark teal metal plates, muted pale mineral-white trim, worn tan edge chips, roughness and normal-map style surface variation, small restrained cyan...
Composition: concept-art quality render, game-ready readability, slightly top-down first-person angle so the primitive construction is visible, matching the cave palette.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no UI, no photoreal aircraft, no sleek sports-car shape, no overdesigned kitbash clutter, no bright white plastic, no obstructive cockpit bars.
- Use dark teal/graphite hull blocks instead of pale plastic cockpit slabs.
- Keep the cockpit low in frame and avoid canopy/fence geometry.
- Build side arms from box housings, cylinders, torus collar rings, and darker barrel cylinders.
- Use tan worn edge plates and muted pale trim as broad readability accents.
- Keep cyan lights sparse and functional, not neon decoration.
Asset class: AI-generated textured FBX model package.
- `texture_0.png` compatibility alias for the FBX embedded texture reference
Target use: active Driftfield cockpit/ship model loaded by `src/visuals.js` with physical runtime LED meshes layered on top.
- The extracted runtime folder is project-owned and should travel with the source archive.
- `texture_0.png` is a copy of the albedo map because the FBX references that filename internally.
- Runtime code applies the explicit PBR maps and keeps human-made cockpit surfaces flat shaded.
